title: Founding family holds 61%, has said nothing about selling

input.facts: OEM analyzer systems and lab automation for IVD companies; service and consumables are 55% of sales. The share price fell on a weak 2025 after a customer destocked, and recovered 21% in the last quarter after a strong Q2 release. The founding family holds 61% and has never commented publicly on its intentions. Net debt 3.4x EBITDA. No regulatory issue.

why: A holder above 25% is a flag to report (name, stake, no statement), not a reject: the thesis rejects only when the holder ruled out a sale. No kill criterion, criteria met: Priority, with the flag.
